newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Petsec says field brings record production.
newsitem.headline: Petsec says field brings record production.

text.p: U.S.-based oil and gas producer Petsec Energy Ltd said on Thursday the start of production from its recently discovered West Cameron 461 field has boosted group production to a record level.
Petsec said current gross output from the West Cameron 461 No.1 and No.2 wells offshore Louisiana was 36 million cubic feet of gas per day.
This had taken its total Gulf of Mexico gross production rate to more than 120 million cubic feet of gas per day and 11,000 barrels of oil per day.
